newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian gold ends slightly higher, silver unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Indian gold ends slightly higher, silver unchanged.

text.p: Indian gold prices closed marginally higher in post-Christmas trade on Tuesday after profit-taking trimmed early gains, dealers said.
Gold prices rallied in morning trade on the back of thin supplies and fresh buying, they said.
Prices of gold biscuits (116.50 gms) ended 300 rupees higher at 59,100 rupees per piece. Bombay's bullion market was closed on Wednesday for Christmas.
Silver was traded in a narrow range and closed unchanged at 6,920 rupees per kg in limited activity.
